subject.title: fix(xai): bound stalled generated video download body reads

question: Should xAI generated-video downloads permanently use half the configured request budget as their per-chunk idle cutoff?
rationale: The implementation and loopback evidence establish the mechanics, but neither the current runtime contract nor provider evidence establishes that a 50% ratio is the intended compatibility boundary for valid xAI CDN responses.

options.title: Approve the half-budget cutoff
options.body: Land the current policy, accepting earlier failure for responses whose inter-chunk silence exceeds half the configured request timeout.

options.title: Choose a different idle policy
options.body: Define a provider-owned floor, cap, or other deadline before merge and add a slow-valid-stream regression for that contract.

options.title: Retain only the total deadline
options.body: Decline a distinct xAI idle policy and close the PR because the existing guarded request timeout already prevents indefinite downloads.

recommendation.title: Approve the half-budget cutoff
recommendation.body: Land the current policy, accepting earlier failure for responses whose inter-chunk silence exceeds half the configured request timeout.

likelyOwner.reason: Their adjacent provider timeout and video-generation history makes them the best available owner for this compatibility choice.
